item.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers! Welcome to our podcast. If you're part of the music industry, or just a fan looking to stay in the know, we've got some exciting news to share with you. Billboard Pro has just launched a brand new music industry events calendar, and it's a game-changer."
[Soft background music continues]
Host: "This comprehensive calendar will feature all the major national and international industry events, from conferences to festivals, and even networking mixers. Whether you're looking to stay up-to-date on the latest trends or connect with other professionals in the field, this calendar has got you covered."
[Short pause]
Host: "Some highlights to look out for include the Grammy Awards on February 7th, 2027, in Los Angeles, and the Electric Daisy Carnival, or EDC, in Las Vegas from May 13th to 24th, 2027. And if you're an event organizer, you can even get your event listed on the calendar by reaching out to joe.maimone@billboard.com."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the flip side. Remember to check out Billboard Pro for all the latest music industry news, charts, and analysis, and don't forget to mark your calendars for these exciting events!"
